notes.title: New Detective Grimoire Game Announced at Day of the Devs
notes.content:
Ahoy, Grimoire Fans!

In collaboration with Day of the Devs: The Game Awards Edition 2023, we are excited to unveil the latest adventure in our beloved Detective Grimoire series: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1696770/The_Mermaids_Tongue/

After navigating the adventures of Tangle Tower, Detective Grimoire and Sally embark on a deep-sea expedition to solve the mysterious murder of Magnus Mortuga, the esteemed captain of the world's strangest submarine.

[previewyoutube=m2-33i6F_hU;full][/previewyoutube]

For aficionados of cosy noir and maritime murder mysteries, you're set for an enthralling dive. Grimoire and Sally will explore uncharted territories, delving into the darkest corners of the submarine and its inhabitants. You'll meet a diverse, fully voiced crew of eccentric suspects. Keep your wits about you as you scrutinise intricately designed underwater environments for clues and unearth hidden secrets in the objects scattered throughout the submarine. Immerse yourself in the hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, performed by the Budapest Art Orchestra and composed by Raphael Benjamin Mayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6468640/9d2ada6f14a66d6f0d24a8d9aece4527d1b0ea31.gif[/img]

Can our intrepid duo navigate these treacherous waters and solve this deep-sea dilemma? Get ready for an exhilarating nautical adventure! Add The Mermaid's Tongue to your wishlist now:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1696770/The_Mermaids_Tongue/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6468640/a3c492580b8c33a740321f0504d8f78f4eacfe35.gif[/img][/url]

New to the Detective Grimoire mysteries? Immerse yourself in our criminally good point-and-click adventures to get cozy with our intrepid detective duo, Grimoire and Sally:

🕵️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/272600/Detective_Grimoire/]Detective Grimoire[/url] 
🎨 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/359510/Tangle_Tower/]Tangle Tower[/url]

Here’s to an enthralling journey to new depths of mystery.

Tom & Adam

notes.title: Detective Grimoire sequel OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/359510/Tangle_Tower/

In Tangle Tower, you play once more as Detective Grimoire - and this time you're joined by Sally from the first game!

Freya Fellow has been murdered. The lead suspect? A shadowy figure found looming over her body, wielding a knife. The problem? That suspect... is just a painting.

[b]If you enjoyed Detective Grimoire, we hope you'll enjoy Tangle Tower too![/b]

In case you were wondering what we were doing for all that time, the first year was figuring out what to do next and starting on Tangle Tower. Then we put everything else on hold for two years to go make Snipperclips with/for Nintendo! After that, and a short break to recuperate, we spent the last two years making Tangle Tower!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6468640/d6efb756b7eb1820e58a29a696c46dddf76fedec.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tangle Tower - A Detective Grimoire Sequel!
notes.content:
After over five years, we're releasing a sequel to Detective Grimoire THIS MONTH!

In Tangle Tower, you play once more as Detective Grimoire - and this time you're joined by Sally from the first game! 

Freya Fellow has been murdered. The lead suspect? A shadowy figure found looming over her body, wielding a knife. The problem? That suspect... is just a painting.

[b]If you enjoyed Detective Grimoire, please wishlist and follow Tangle Tower, it helps so so much![/b]

In case you were wondering what we were doing for all that time, the first year was figuring out what to do next and starting on Tangle Tower, then we put everything else on hold for two years to go make Snipperclips with/for Nintendo! After that, and a short break to recuperate, we spent the last two years making Tangle Tower! We really hope you'll enjoy it.

notes.title: Soundtrack Out Now! Free upgrade for all existing customers!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've just released the soundtrack to [b]Detective Grimoire[/b] as DLC to the main game! Our composer [b]Raphael Benjamin Meyer[/b] did an amazing job, and his work really shines in the hands of the talented musicians he brought on board to play for us.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/421950/

We've also added a Soundtrack Edition which includes the game and the soundtrack DLC, at a slightly discounted price.

As a special thank you to everyone who already bought the game, [b]we've upgraded you all to the Soundtrack Edition![/b] If we hadn't, then the DLC would have had to be full price to all our early supporters, compared to the discounted bundle that new customers can get, and that just wouldn't be right.

We've also just released the soundtrack to our other game here on Steam, [b]Haunt the House: Terrortown[/b], also from our amazing composer Raphael Benjamin Meyer!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/421940/

We hope you enjoy them both!

Tom & Adam

notes.title: Out now for Linux!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've finally released the Linux version of Detective Grimoire here on Steam! We had some delays with distribution licences, but we're all good to go now. 

Those of you who already bought a copy of the game will find the Linux version available for download in your Steam libraries!

I should mention here too that this game runs with Adobe AIR, but we managed to get a licence to distribute it as a standalone runtime, that doesn't install, it just sits there in the games directory, and can be completely removed just by deleting that directory. That should mitigate any security concerns, since the Linux AIR is so old now! It should also run pretty well on a lot more distros than the usual AIR install!

Cheers,
Tom-

notes.content:
